name: Futatsuguri Kikuno
source:
Passed away in 2016 at the age of 88.
The second wife to Kaemon, a past leader of the Futatsuguri clan, and mother to Munetaka.
In her lifetime, Kikuno effectively managed the entire household and was well-versed in the esoteric realms of jujutsu, marking her as a distinguished woman of her era.

"You see, a curse begins the very moment we are born into this world."
